Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 65
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 16408 of 2023
Applicant :- Anil Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Haseen Ahmad,Sipte Husain Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

By means of present application, the applicant has challenged the bailable warrant dated 12.11.2013 as well as further proceeding of Complaint Case no. 1128 of 2013, under section 26/59 and 63 of Food Safety Act and Standard Act, pending in the court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate-I,
Bulandshahr.

entities.text: Food Safety Act and Standard Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: At the very outset, learned AGA for the State has submitted that the bailable warrant has been issued by the court below vide order dated 12.11.2013, however, the instant application has been filed after an expiry of more than nine and half years, as such, the present application is hopelessly barred by laches.
It is further submitted that the said laches has not been explained at all, in the absence of which, the present application do not deserve any indulgence by this Court.
Anil Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88985602/

entities.text: Anil Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicant has not been able to give any reasonable explanation for the said laches.
In view of the above, the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is liable to be dismissed on the ground of laches and it is accordingly dismissed.
